title: The Dog Got the Fig
lines: The fig sat on a mat. The dog got up.
Nip! The dog got the fig.
Nan is mad at the dog.
The dog did dig in the mud.
The dog dug up a fig!
It is a mud fig. Nan got it.
Nan is not mad. The dog got a pat.

questions.ask: What did the dog take off the mat?
questions.listenFor: The fig. The story says it. If your child is unsure, have them find the word fig and read that line again.

questions.ask: Why did Nan stop being mad?
questions.listenFor: Because the dog dug up another fig for her. Listen for the dog making it right, not just "she stopped."

questions.ask: Would you eat a fig that came out of the mud? Tell me why or why not.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason - it is dirty, or you could wash it. The reason is the thinking you want.
